description: Retrieve metadata and the file manifest for an Internet Archive item by identifier. Returns title, creator, description (as plain text), subjects, collections, license, language, publisher, ISBN, OCLC and LCCN numbers, Open Library edition and work IDs, volume, the page-image count of a text item, whether the item is access-restricted, the total file count, and a page of files, each with its format, size, and direct download URL; a file marked private cannot be downloaded. Pages hold up to max_files files (default 50, at most 500 per call) starting at file_offset; set format to keep a single file type (e.g. "DjVuTXT", "Text PDF", "VBR MP3"). The primary tool to act on a search result from ia_search_items. Use ia_get_text to retrieve the readable text of a text item.

file_offset.description: Zero-based position in the (format-filtered) file list to start from (default 0). To read the next page, add the number of files returned to the previous file_offset, or pass the file_offset the notice names.

format.description: Keep only files whose format equals this value, ignoring case — e.g. "DjVuTXT", "Text PDF", "VBR MP3". Applied before paging. Omit to list every format.

identifier.description: Internet Archive item identifier, e.g. "prideprejudice00aust" (Pride and Prejudice), from ia_search_items results; or an archive.org item URL, such as https://archive.org/details/prideprejudice00aust or its download, stream, metadata, or embed form, read as the identifier it names.

max_files.description: Maximum number of files to return (default 50). One call returns at most 500: a larger value (up to 300,000) is served as 500, with a notice naming the next file_offset.

name: ia_get_item

access_restricted.description: Present when the item is in an access-restricted collection, such as a lending library. Whether a download is refused is per file: see each file’s private.

cap.description: The page size applied: max_files, or 500 when a larger value was capped.

collection.description: Collection(s) this item belongs to when provided.

creator.description: Creator or author name(s) when provided.

date.description: Publication or upload date when provided; a few records carry a list, relayed as received.

anyOf.description: Multiple descriptions, each as plain text.

description.description:
Item description when provided, converted from the HTML the Archive stores to plain text:
and each paragraph, div, or list item start a new line, existing line breaks are kept, and a link reads as its label followed by its URL in parentheses.

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `invalid_identifier`: identifier holds "/" or ":" but is not an archive.org item URL: a URL on another site, a Wayback Machine capture, or an archive.org page that names no item. `item_not_found`: The identifier does not exist in the Internet Archive. `archive_unavailable`: The Internet Archive Metadata API did not answer within the request timeout, could not be reached, answered HTTP 5xx after retries, 429, or another 4xx, or sent an unreadable response. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

file_count.description: Total number of files in the full item manifest, before filtering and paging.

files.description: This page of the manifest in upstream order — up to max_files files (at most 500) from file_offset, after the format filter.

items.description: A single file in the item manifest.

download_url.description: Direct download URL for this file.

private.description: Present when the manifest marks this file private: the Archive refuses its download, so ia_get_text cannot read it.

image_count.description: Number of scanned page images of a texts item, covers and calibration cards included — not a printed page count. Omitted for other media types, where the Archive counts something else.

language.description: Language(s) of the item when provided.

lccn.description: Library of Congress Control Number(s) when provided.

notice.description: Paging guidance with the next file_offset, or the formats present when the filter matched nothing.

openlibrary_edition.description: Open Library edition ID (e.g. "OL7173379M") when provided.

openlibrary_work.description: Open Library work ID (e.g. "OL66554W") when provided.

publisher.description: Publisher statement (e.g. "London : George Allen") when provided; a few records carry a list, relayed as received.

shown.description: Number of files returned on this page.

subject.description: Subject or topic tag(s) when provided.

title.description: Item title when provided; a few records carry a list, relayed as received.

totalCount.description: Number of files matching the format filter, before paging.

truncated.description: True when more files remain past this page.

title: Get Internet Archive Item
